title: A nitrogen changes neighbors
hook: Count the atoms and trace their bonds.

knows: Condensed structural formulas and covalent bonds.
doesNotKnow: Both structures have formula C₂H₇N, but their atoms connect differently. ethylamine and dimethylamine are constitutional isomers.

misconception: Different-looking structural drawings must represent different formulas or different compounds.
objective: Compare molecular formula and connectivity when classifying two structures.

claims.text: Structure A is ethylamine (C₂H₇N); structure B is dimethylamine (C₂H₇N). Both structures have formula C₂H₇N, but their atoms connect differently. ethylamine and dimethylamine are constitutional isomers.
Constitutional isomers have the same molecular formula but different atomic connectivity.
The diagrams show condensed connectivity, not stereochemistry or molecular geometry.
Recall: What relationship do ethylamine and dimethylamine have? Both structures have formula C₂H₇N, but their atoms connect differently. ethylamine and dimethylamine are constitutional isomers.
